profile.name: Nathin Pillay
profile.headline: DIVE INTO THE CREATIVE STORM.
profile.intro: A multidisciplinary creative. An artist. An incurably curious mind. Turning a million possibilities into something that matters.
profile.about: I’m kinda weird, but also ambitious and thrive under pressure. I enjoy taking things to the next level and I’ll always crack a joke, sometimes when I shouldn’t, but I heard that creatives are supposed to be a little crazy.

projects.description: Over the years I have grown as an artist in parallel to my design career, having exhibited in the KZNSA art gallery, Art in the Park, etc. I am also very grateful to have been mentored by the renowned artist, Ashley Munsamy.
paragraphs: Over the years I have grown as an artist in parallel to my design career, having exhibited in the KZNSA art gallery, Art in the Park, etc. I am also very grateful to have been mentored by the renowned artist, Ashley Munsamy.

In this first artwork, I was selected by the South African Indian Consulate and the DG ICCR in India to be sent to New Delhi and paint alongside 10 artists from the allied countries in the BRICS 2026 Summit. The work was received highly positive recognition from the delegates and presidents of the allied countries, including Putin, Xi Jinping, Modi, etc.

ai.title: Generating Reality.
ai.intro: I wanted images that could stand up to an art director’s eye. So I built a custom AI image-generation system around one very human obsession: making the imagined feel real.
ai.detail: This is a bespoke image-generation system developed around my own creative standards. Believable skin. Materials with character. Light that belongs in the scene. From the expression on a face to the texture of a surface, the aim is to bring the discipline of photography and art direction into every generated image. It gives me the freedom to create ambitious visuals with a consistent point of view, shaped for the brief and refined beyond the first result. The technology opens the possibilities. My eye decides what makes the cut.
ai.printNote: Large-format artwork can be prepared to a specified print brief, including 500 dpi where the agreed dimensions and source detail support it. Every deliverable is assessed at its intended output size.
